paper_scope: A reproducible comparison of selected 3DGS renderers and compression codecs on one frozen five-scene NVIDIA A100 cohort.

contributions.statement: A cohort-safe protocol and artifact contract for comparing 3DGS renderers without mixing hardware, checkpoints, cameras, quality references, or evidence tiers.
A complete five-renderer by five-scene A100 matrix with raw timing samples, quality metrics, memory, and immutable provenance.
A five-scene compression case study that applies the same provenance and quality-gate discipline.

claims.statement: Suite v3.1.0 fixes five required 1920x1080 cases under protocol matrix-primary-1080p-v2.
The measured A100 cohort contains five renderer configurations, each covering all five required cases.
Within the frozen A100 cohort, gsplat_higs has a 5.671367x speed index and 696.910476 aggregate FPS.
SPZ 8/8 passes the near-lossless gate on all five scenes at 5.572191x to 6.072361x compression and under 0.02 dB absolute PSNR change.
The renderer ordering generalizes across data-center and consumer GPU architectures.
claims.blocking_gate: Run the frozen matrix on at least two additional GPU architectures, including one consumer GPU, and publish separate cohorts.

claims.statement: An independent operator reproduced the headline matrix from a clean environment.
claims.blocking_gate: Accept one externally operated, provenance-complete result submission and record its clean-environment procedure.

claims.statement: The paper artifact has an immutable archival DOI.
claims.blocking_gate: Create a tagged release, archive the checksummed bundle, then add the issued DOI to CITATION.cff.

claims.statement: HiGS training changes constitute a separate novel optimization method.
claims.rationale: The benchmark paper keeps method authorship and its extensive optimization study separate from the primary independent comparison; the tracked round artifacts remain available for a dedicated method paper.
